trials.name: Trial of Humility
trials.description: Gain 1 Saint point each time this model is targeted by an enemy unit's attack and survives.

trials.name: Trial of Purity
trials.description: Gain 1 Saint point each time this model destroys an enemy PSYKER unit.

trials.name: Trial of Zeal
trials.description: Gain 1 Saint point each time this model destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase.

trials.name: Trial of Faith
trials.description: Gain 1 Saint point each time this model performs an Act of Faith.

trials.name: Trial of Sacrifice
trials.description: Gain 1 Saint point each time this model suffers a Devastating Blow.

trials.name: Trial of Martyrdom
trials.description: Gain 1 Saint point each time this model is destroyed.
